github.comment: Plan-mode agent tasks: get_issue, get_issue_comments, and post issue comments via MCP. Runners use github-mcp-server (see docker/agent-entrypoint.sh).

posthog.comment: Optional for local orchestrator dev. Create a personal API key with the MCP Server preset. Pin project_id in the URL or headers when you use one key across environments.

sqlite-queue.comment: Debugging convenience only. The server container holds this file open in WAL mode across a Docker bind mount, and WAL's shared-memory file does not cross the macOS VM boundary reliably — reads here can be stale or hit locking errors. Use GET /api/agent/tasks for anything that matters. See README.md.
